The included standard-library checker and recorded execution output agree. Unstable cell attaching maps are not evaluated, and no homotopy wedge statement is made.

value.rationale: The compact seven-fused-hexagon coronene graph is a canonical fully planar nonstrip hexagonal example, scientifically motivated by active recent classification of strip independence complexes. Its exact mixed-degree integral homology, natural twelve-symmetry dihedral character, and exhaustive subgroup rational quotient description are nontrivial intrinsic invariants; ordinary Betti numbers alone do not imply the representation or quotient dichotomy. The exact finite benchmark can inform calculations on wider benzenoid patches without implying any unproved general theorem or needing a paper-sized result.
